question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping’s centralized authority within the Chinese Communist Party, reinforced by anti-corruption campaigns that removed potential rivals from military and senior party ranks, underpins the 95.7% trader consensus against his removal before 2027. No designated successor has emerged, and norms of generational turnover were bypassed after his third term, positioning the 21st Party Congress in 2027 as the likely venue for a fourth term rather than a transition. Public appearances, policy continuity through mid-2026, and ongoing elite alignment around his leadership signal stability. Abrupt health events, severe economic setbacks, or unexpected fractures in party institutions remain low-probability developments that could still shift the outcome before year-end 2026.
